translation_en: I had double eyelid surgery (incisional) at Haneulbit Sinsa branch (하늘빛 신사점). Director Kim Do-yoon performed the surgery himself, and before the operation they also had me sign a consent form for CCTV recording in the operating room. They first quoted 1,800,000 won, but there was a promotion so I got it done for 1,500,000 won. The swelling had mostly gone down by the second week, and the line looks natural, so I'm satisfied. I'm attaching a photo of the receipt as proof.

This is my rhinoplasty review for Haneulbit Plastic Surgery (Haneulbit Seonghyeongoegwa), Gangnam Station branch. Everyone was so kind, from the consultation all the way through the surgery, and the result is perfect! There was almost no swelling and my recovery was fast too. I strongly recommend it to anyone who is worried about their nose. ※ This post was written after receiving support for the procedure cost from the clinic.

side_effects: Numbness at one corner of the mouth for about 3 months, now mostly recovered
translation_en: I had facial contouring at Bomnal Plastic Surgery (봄날성형외과; it has since been renamed Saebom Plastic Surgery / 새봄성형외과). I did cheekbones + square jaw together, and it cost 9,000,000 KRW (900만원) in total. As a side effect, one corner of my mouth was numb for about 3 months, but the feeling has almost completely come back now.

I had eye-shape correction (ptosis correction) and epicanthoplasty (medial epicanthoplasty) at Onyu Plastic Surgery (온유성형외과). The director is really meticulous, and I'm extremely satisfied with the result! The price is reasonable too. I recommend it!!

I got 1cc of chin filler at Misoline Clinic (미소라인의원), and it was 250,000 won. I found out later that the director isn't a board-certified plastic surgeon. The result is decent, but I think next time I'll go to a clinic with a specialist.

procedures: Scar laser treatment (scheduled, not yet received)
side_effects: Scar on the left side is still somewhat red at 3 months post-op
translation_en: This is my 3-month review of double eyelid surgery at Haneulbit Sinsa branch (하늘빛 신사점). The line has settled, but the scar on the left side is still a bit red. The director (원장님) said they would do the scar laser treatment for free, so I'm getting it next week.
verifier_issues: translation_en calls the director 'he', but the original (원장님이 ... 해주신다고) never says the director's gender. Use gender-neutral wording.

translation_en: Got double eyelid surgery at Haneulbit (Sinsa branch) in July. Paid 1.6M KRW through an agency - later found out locals paid 1.5M, so the agency clearly took a cut. Dr. Kim was great, but the agency's interpreter rushed the consult and I never got the aftercare sheet in English.
